deployment_statement: V1 provides very strong detection of DDoS, DoS, MQTT flooding, and most reconnaissance traffic at approximately 0.08% observed benign FPR, but does not reliably detect ARP spoofing, MQTT malformed-data attacks, or some low-volume reconnaissance types.
known_limitations: Aggregate attack recall is dominated by high-volume DDoS/DoS windows and overstates Spoofing / low-volume type performance.
ARP Spoofing recall is ~8% on TEST; V1 features do not encode IP-MAC identity consistency.
MQTT_Malformed_Data recall is ~23% despite strong MQTT flood detection.
Recon types are heterogeneous (Port Scan strong; VulScan weak).
Profiling benign TEST support is only 60 windows; zero profiling FPs is not strong device-generalization evidence.
next: V1 is closed for selection and evaluation. Any successor (V2+) must be designed without using this TEST set for model, feature, or threshold decisions.
